stem.text: Three resistors are connected to a cell of negligible internal resistance.
Which circuit has a combined resistance of $100\,\Omega$?

A.alt: Circuit diagram with a cell and three resistors labelled 100 Ω, 100 Ω and 50 Ω, connected in a combination of series and parallel branches.

B.alt: Circuit diagram with a cell and three resistors labelled 50 Ω, 100 Ω and 100 Ω, connected in a combination of series and parallel branches.

C.alt: Circuit diagram with a cell and three resistors labelled 100 Ω, 100 Ω and 50 Ω, connected in parallel.

D.alt: Circuit diagram with a cell and three resistors labelled 100 Ω, 100 Ω and 50 Ω, connected in series.
